subject: Request: Nighttime P1/P2 handoff risk & temporary SLA bridge
messages:
From: Alan Cho <alan.cho@greenpeak.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Night coverage risk — potential P1 delay next week

Hi Sean,

Quick note from GreenPeak's ops team: we learned that one of our on-call engineers will be unavailable across the June 23–26 overnight window for an emergency deployment. That creates a potential gap in our primary responder rotation between 2300–0400 PT.

We rely on Redwood's P1 response SLA for our monitoring-alert-driven pipelines; this gap could push a P1 acknowledgement beyond our contract's 30-minute target during the affected nights.

Can Redwood confirm whether you can provide a temporary bridging commitment (either an on-call carve-in or an SLA waiver for these specific windows) and any compensating controls you can implement (e.g., auto-failover routing, accelerated paging, or extra escalation steps)?

We'd like a short written plan by EOD today so we can schedule our deployment accordingly.

Thanks,
Alan
Sr. Reliability Engineer
GreenPeak Systems

Attachments: none
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Cho <alan.cho@greenpeak.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Night coverage risk — potential P1 delay next week

Alan — thanks for the heads up. Sorry to hear about the overlap; we can propose a short-term bridging plan. Below is what I'm proposing internally and to you as a customer-facing commitment for the 23–26 window.

Proposed temporary bridge (Redwood):
- On-call carve-in: our night tertiary responder will be staged to GreenPeak's paging policy for 2300–0400 PT (adds a 20min additional responder headcount on those nights).
- Conditional SLA waiver: if acknowledgment exceeds 30 minutes solely due to the rotation gap during the specified window, Redwood will not automatically trigger a P1 credit. Instead, we will accept a documented incident review and, depending on findings, apply a one-time service credit up to 5% for the affected billing period.
- Operational compensations: enable auto-failover to the secondary model-serving cluster in us-west-2 (no code changes required), and temporarily lower the paging threshold to reduce noise for faster triage.

Needs from your side:
- Formal confirmation from GreenPeak that the affected window is exactly 23–26 June and permission for Redwood to be paged under your existing policy.
- Acceptance of the conditional credit approach (we'll draft the waiver language).

Internal asks (marissa, ben, laura):
- Marissa: need CS approval to accept conditional credit and to communicate to the customer.
- Ben: legal/contract confirmation that a short DocuSign amendment or addendum is sufficient (we should avoid full SOW changes).
- Laura: ops to confirm on-call carve-in logistics and attach proposed rota.

I'll attach a short draft waiver and an ops rota in the next email. If we can sign off by noon PT I can send GreenPeak the formal doc and page ops runbook.

—Sean
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sla-bridge-proposal-20270621.docx (draft)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Quick read — I approve this approach from CS. A few notes:

- Customer empathy: lead with the mitigation (on-call carve-in and auto-failover) and then the conditional credit; customers prefer the operational fixes first.
- Communication cadence: send the formal waiver and a one-line runbook summary they can attach to their change request.
- Escalation path: add an explicit step that if the tertiary responder does not acknowledge within 45m, the on-call lead (Laura) is paged and then Ben (for contractual exceptions).

I'm good to communicate once Ben and Laura confirm the legal and ops bits.

—Marissa
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Night coverage risk — potential P1 delay next week

Agree with Marissa's framing. Legal check: a one-page addendum referencing the existing Master Service Agreement (MSA) is fine. Two items I need before I sign off:

1) Precise SLA language: "For incidents occurring during 23–26 June 2027 between 23:00–04:00 PT, Redwood will deploy a temporary tertiary responder and enable auto-failover. If a P1 acknowledgment exceeds 30 minutes solely due to the rotation gap, the parties agree to a one-time credit not to exceed 5% of the monthly invoice for the impacted billing month."

2) Auditability: ops must provide a short log extract showing pagings and acknowledgments for any incident that claims the exemption. That ensures we can verify the cause.

If ops can provide the rota and a sample logging extract, I'll prepare the DocuSign addendum and route to GreenPeak.

—Ben
Senior Contracts Counsel
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Alan Cho <alan.cho@greenpeak.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Night coverage risk — potential P1 delay next week

All right — ops can run the carve-in. Attached is the proposed rota and the schedule changes for 23–26 Jun. I've also included a sample extract of the paging log format we can provide for auditability.

Summary of operational commitments:
- Tertiary responder added to GreenPeak paging group 23:00–04:00 PT on Jun 23, 24, 25, 26.
- Paging threshold lowered by 20% for your critical alerts during those windows.
- Auto-failover to secondary cluster will be enabled at 23:10 PT (to limit unnecessary churn we enable after monitoring confirms sustained failure).
- We'll capture page->ack timestamps and provide CSV extracts within 48 hours of any incident.

Alan — if that matches your expectations, please reply with a one-line confirmation and we will issue the DocuSign addendum for signature.

Attachments: oncall-bridge-rotas.pdf (ops rota), sla-bridge-proposal-20270621.docx (updated with Ben's language)

—Laura
